# Steam — cart-ambush completion dialog loop

- Original source: [Steam — cart-ambush completion dialog loop](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/802345327968471760/)
- Author / publication: GrandDuke and Wanoo / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; displayed opening April 19, year omitted
- Access: Opening and sole reply inspected through direct HTML retrieval
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

GrandDuke reports being unable to complete a side robbery after collecting money during a cart ambush. A popup returns after acknowledging it, apparently before the player can use another confirmation control on the right.

The sole visible reply suggests asking elsewhere and requests that a solution be shared. It supplies no fix.

The report does not identify the exact ambush variant, executable version, save file, or input configuration. It is therefore an unresolved reproduction lead, not a diagnosed scripting or interface bug.
